senses.gloss:
(उ) भ्रंशु r. 4th cl. (भ्रंश्यति)
To fall down; also भ्रंस.

m. (-शः)
1 Falling, declining from a height, or from propriety.
2 Falling from or off.
E.
भ्रंश to fall, aff. अच्.

(उ) भ्रंसु r. 1st cl. (भ्रंसते)
To fall down.

m. (-सः)
An actor wearing female apparel.
E.
भ्र for भ्रू the eye-brow, and कुशि or कुसि to speak, aff. अच्; hence also भ्रकुंश, भ्रूकुंस, &c.

f. (-टिः-टी)
A frown.
E.
भ्र for भ्रू the eye-brow, कुट to curve, aff. इन्; also भ्रुकुटि, &c.

r. 1st cl. (भ्रणति)
To sound.

(उ) भ्रमु r. 1st cl. (भ्रमति भ्रम्यति)
1 To turn round, to move circularly.
2 To be unsteady or unfixed.
3 To roam, to wander; it is also figuratively applicable to mental [] unsteadiness, as to err, to wander, to be ignorant or mistaken, &c.
With परि,
To wander about.
With वि,
To play, to wanton.
With सम्,
1 To hurry.
2 To honour.

m. (-मः)
1 Whirling, going round.
2 Straying, roaming.
3 Error, ignorance, mistake, misapprehension.
4 A whirlpool, an eddy.
5 A drain, a water-course.
6 A lathe, a potter's wheel, &c.
E.
भ्रम to go round, aff. अप्.

m. (-मः)
1 Wandering, roving.
2 Error.
E.
भ्रम to turn round, घञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Whirling, going round.
2 Wandering, literally or figuratively.
f. (-णी)
1 A leech.
2 A sort of game, performed by women for the amusement of a lover or husband.
E.
भ्रम to go round, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्)
1 Going round, whirling, revolving.
2 Roving.
3 Erring.
E.
भ्रम to turn round, शतृ aff.

f. (-टी)
An umbrella, a concave mat carried on the head for that purpose, &c.
E.
भ्रमत्, and कुटी a house.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
What whirls or goes round.
m. (-रः)
1 A large black bee.
2 A lecher, a lover.
n. (-रं)
Vertigo, epilepsy.
E.
भ्रम to go round, aff. करन्.

n. (-रं)
1 Whirling, going round.
2 A dance performed in a ring, dancing round-about.
3 A village.
4 Epilepsy.
5 Honey.
m. (-रः)
A sort of loadstone.
f. (-री)
1 A name of PĀRVATĪ, from her having assumed the form of a bee, in order to contend with MAHĀSURA.
2 A Yoginī, or female attendant on DURGĀ.
E.
भ्रमर a bee, &c. aff., अण् or अञ्.

m. (-कः)
1 Hair curled upon the forehead.
2 A bee.
3 A ball for playing with.
4 A whirlpool.
E.
भ्रमर a bee, &c., कन् aff.

m. (-टः)
A sort of wasp, that builds a solitary nest in the angles of walls, doors, &c., (Vespa solitaria.)
E.
भ्रमर a bee, and कीट an insect.

m. (-यः)
A sort of Kadamba tree.
E.
भ्रमर a bee, and प्रिय beloved.

f. (-ता)
A species of the Triṣṭubh metre.

m. (-कः)
Hair curled upon the forehead.
E.
भ्रमर a bee, and अलक a curl.

m. (-क्तः)
An armourer, a sword-cleaner, a knifegrinder.
E.
भ्रस a turning instrument, a grindstone, and आसक्त diligent.

f. (-मिः)
1 Whirling, going round.
2 Error, blunder, mistake.
3 A lathe, a potter's wheel.
4 A whirlpool.
E.
भ्रम to turn round, Uṇādi aff. इन्.

mfn. (-मी-मिणी-मि)
Whirling, going round or about.
E.
भ्रम to go round, aff. घिनुण्.

(उ) भ्रशु r. 4th cl. (भ्रश्यति)
To fall down; also भृश and भ्रंश.

(टु, ऋ) टुभ्राशृ r. 1st cl. (भ्राशते भ्राश्यते)
To shine.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Fallen, lost.
2 Vicious, depraved, fallen from virtue.
3 Fried, parched.
E.
भ्रंश to fall, or भ्रस्ज to fry, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं)
Deposed, deprived of a kingdom.
E.
भ्रष्ट, and राज्य principality.

(औ) औभ्रस्ज r. 6th cl. (भ्रज्जति-ते)
To broil or fry.

(टु, ऋ) टुभ्राजृ r. 1st cl. (भ्राजते)
To shine.

n. (-कं)
Bile, the bilious humour.
E.
भ्राज to shine, aff. ण्वुन्.

f. (-थुः)
Brilliance, splendour, beauty.
E.
भ्राज to shine, अथुच् aff.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
1 Splendid.
2 Beautiful.
E.
भ्राजथु, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
Elegant, splendid, radiant in ornament and vesture.
E.
भ्राज to shine, aff. इष्णुच्.

m. (-ता)
A brother, a uterine brother.
Dual only, (-रौ)
Brother and sister.
E.
भ्राज to shine, Uṇādi aff. तृच्, and the radical final rejected.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Fraternal, brotherly, of or belonging to a brother.
E.
भ्रातृ a brother, and ठञ् aff.

m. (-जः)
A brother's son.
E.
भ्रातृ a brother, and ज born.

f. (-या)
A sister-in-law, a brother's wife.
E.
भ्रातृ a brother, and जाया a wife.

f. (-त्नी)
A brother's wife.
E.
भ्रातृ, and पत्नी a wife.

dual only, (-न्यौ)
A brother and sister.
E.
भ्रातृ a brother, and भगिनी a sister.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Having a brother.
E.
भ्रतृ, and वलच् aff.

m. (-व्यः)
1 A brother's son.
2 An enemy.
E.
भ्रातृ a brother, and तव्य aff.

m. (-रः)
A husband's elder brother.
E.
भ्रातृ a brother, and श्वशुर a father-in-law, (as it were.)

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Fraternal, belonging or relating to a brother.
m. (-यः)
A brother's son.
E.
भ्रातृ a brother, and छ aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Whirled, revolved.
2 Blundering, mistaken.
E.
भ्रम to revolve, aff. क्त.

f. (-न्तिः)
1 Error, mistake, ignorance.
2 Going round, whirling, revolving.
3 Unsteadiness, locomotion.
4 Going about, wandering.
E.
भ्रम to go round, aff. क्तिन्, and the vowel made long.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
1 Erring, mistaking.
2 Wandering.
E.
भ्रान्ति, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-रः)
A counsellor, a minister.
E.
भ्रान्ति error, and हर who repels or removes.

m. (-कः)
1 A jackal.
2 A cheat, a rogue.
3 A sort of loadstone.
4 The sun-flower.
E.
भ्रम to turn round, ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
1 Whirling round.
2 Bewildering.
E.
भ्रम to wander or whirl, causal v., शतृ aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Whirling, revolving.
2 Epileptic, giddy.
3 Made of honey or from a bee, &c.
E.
भ्रामर, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-म्यन्-म्यती-भ्यत्)
1 Wandering about. roving, roaming.
2 Erring, deviating.
E.
भ्रम to wander, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-ष्ट्रः-ष्ट्री-ष्ट्रं)
Fried in a pan.
mn. (ष्ट्रः-ष्ट्रं)
A frying pan.
E.
भ्रस्ज to fry, Uṇādi aff. ष्ट्रन्; and in the attributive, अण् added.
